description: This is a Zephyr RTOS-based Bluetooth central device sample code implementing periodic advertising synchronization transfer (PAST). It manages Bluetooth connections, scans for devices, handles periodic advertising sync, and transfers sync to a connected device.

methods.name: data_cb
methods.description: Callback to parse BLE advertisement data, extracts device name.

methods.name: phy2str
methods.description: Converts PHY type value to human-readable string.

methods.name: scan_recv
methods.description: Handles received BLE scan results, initiates connection or sync based on advertisement properties.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth connection event, starts scanning for periodic advertising.

methods.name: sync_cb
methods.description: Callback for when periodic advertising sync is established.

methods.name: term_cb
methods.description: Callback for when periodic advertising sync terminates.

methods.name: recv_cb
methods.description: Callback for receiving data from periodic advertising sync.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth, managing connection, scanning, and periodic advertising sync transfer loop.
